guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：可觀測性與分散式追蹤
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Observability and distributed tracing
guides.concept: 以遙測語義、context 與可靠採樣連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen technical units connect telemetry semantics, context and reliable sampling through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
procedure: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「三類訊號」的資料、控制與時間關係。Metrics、logs 與 traces 回答不同問題。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「將問題配對適當訊號。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「Histogram」的資料、控制與時間關係。桶與分位數估計受到邊界影響。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較兩組桶界與 p99。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「Context 傳播」的資料、控制與時間關係。跨邊界需明確傳遞與驗證 context。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較遺失與有效標頭。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「Tail sampling」的資料、控制與時間關係。尾部採樣需等待與緩衝 trace。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「估算延遲 trace 的儲存。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「資料容量」的資料、控制與時間關係。span 數與大小共同決定原始量。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「重算本課 40 MB/s。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「根因證據」的資料、控制與時間關係。關聯不等於獨立因果證明。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「列出兩個可反駁假說。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for signal types. Metrics, logs and traces answer different questions. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Match questions to signals. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for histograms. Buckets and quantiles depend on boundaries. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare bucket boundaries and p99. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for context propagation. Context crosses boundaries through explicit validation/propagation. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare missing and valid headers. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for tail sampling. Tail decisions require trace waits/buffers. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Estimate delayed-trace storage. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for data volume. Span count and size determine raw volume. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Recalculate the 40 MB/s example. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for causal evidence. Correlation does not establish independent causality. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: List two falsifiable hypotheses. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
evidence: 提交「隱私與保存」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「分類敏感欄位與保存期。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
提交「根因證據」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「關聯不等於獨立因果證明。」。
提交「根因證據」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「列出兩個可反駁假說。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
evidenceEn: Submit privacy and retention input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
Submit causal evidence two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.
Submit causal evidence input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：Trace 時間相近就證明唯一根因。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
pitfallsEn: Common mistake: Nearby trace times prove a unique root cause. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.

guides.scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
guides.scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

courses.overview: 由遙測語義、context 與可靠採樣延伸；共用概念不代表可原封不動搬移全部規格或程式。
courses.overviewEn: Extend telemetry semantics, context and reliable sampling; shared concepts do not imply unchanged specifications or code.

related.title: 服務網格與流量控制
related.why: 代理可提供服務呼叫證據
related.transfer: 代理可提供服務呼叫證據
related.difference: 觀測結果不自動改變流量與授權政策
related.differenceEn: Telemetry does not automatically change traffic/authorization policy
practice: 由「三類訊號」畫出兩課共用與需要重定義的資料、控制及時間邊界。
針對「觀測結果不自動改變流量與授權政策」各指定一個能辨識差異的實驗；只使用虛構資料或明確授權隔離環境。
將本課算例移植到衍生課：逐項重查方程適用條件、單位、版本、故障假設，標示不能沿用的數字。
practiceEn: From signal types, map shared and redefined data, control and timing boundaries.
For "Telemetry does not automatically change traffic/authorization policy", specify a discriminating experiment for each course using fictional data or an explicitly authorized isolated environment.
Transfer the worked example: recheck equation scope, units, versions and fault assumptions; mark values that cannot carry over.
